main_text.p: Hîc divido 2135 per 32 & proveniunt 66 Thaleri, & remanent 23, quos per 19 in bat-zenos duco, sic:
Nunc 437 per superiorem Diviforem nempe 32, divido, & exurgunt 13 batzeni, ac remanent 21, quos per 14 in numulos re-solvo, sic:
Iam per diviforem divido, & proveniunt 9 numuli & 6/32, quae per 2 ad minimam ducuntur, sic: 3/16. Constant igitur ulnae 53 & 3/8, Thaleris 66, batzenis 13, numulis 9 & tribus 16 numuli.
Tres mercatores inito confortio, lucra-ti sunt 288 aureos. Primus autem contulit2/5

page.notes: The fractions 6/32 and 3/16 and 3/8 are read from small, damaged type and are not fully certain; the numerator and denominator in the first fraction may be misread. Fraction 2/5 stands in the right margin beside the last line. The division layouts are reproduced as one line per printed row, with rows read top to bottom.
